soft_spots: THESIS numeric error: 'weeping shows up for the last time about thirty surahs from the end' is false — weep-last is surah 53, i.e. 61 surahs from the end (114). The '30' is the GAP between weep-last (53) and laugh-last (83); laughter continues ~30 surahs LONGER. Exhibit states this correctly ('laughter continues for thirty more surahs'); thesis prose must be fixed.

Scope/cherry-pick framing: thesis calls these 'two ordinary human reactions entering together', but weeping-as-emotion appears earlier at 5:83 ('eyes overflow with tears', root دمع). Bracket holds only at the VERB/root level (b-k-y). Article must be explicit it tracks the verbs laugh/weep, not the concept of crying, or a one-tweet rebuttal ('crying enters at 5:83') lands. (Claim still survives: دمع also stops before 53:60.)
